config.title: Configure Your AI Assistant in One Minute.
config.subtitle: Select your AI client or web assistant and follow the simple setup steps.
claude_web_steps: Open Settings on claude.ai (click your profile avatar in the lower-left).
Select 'Connectors' in the settings menu, then click 'Add custom connector'.
Set Name to 'WaqfTech Islamic Suite' and URL to 'https://mcp.waqf.dev/mcp'.
In any chat, click the '+' button next to the prompt composer, select 'Connectors', and toggle WaqfTech ON.
chatgpt_web_steps: Open Settings on chatgpt.com and navigate to 'Security and login'.
In the Apps / Connectors section, click 'Create / Add Connection (+)'.
Set Name: 'WaqfTech Islamic Suite', Method: 'HTTPS', Endpoint URL: 'https://mcp.waqf.dev/mcp', and Auth: 'None'.
In chat, click the '+' icon in the prompt composer, choose 'Developer mode', and select WaqfTech to query Islamic sources.
gemini_web_steps: Gemini Web Note: gemini.google.com currently supports prompt-based Custom Gems; direct third-party MCP GUI connectors are rolling out via Gemini Agent Platform.
Option A (Official Gemini CLI): Run 'gemini mcp add waqf-islamic-suite https://mcp.waqf.dev/mcp' to enable full tool execution.
Option B (Gemini Web Gem): Create a Custom Gem at gemini.google.com/gems and instruct it with your queries referencing Waqf MCP.
Option C (Gemini Enterprise): Add a StreamableHTTP custom MCP data store pointing to 'https://mcp.waqf.dev/mcp'.
config.config_note: Tip: Use '?suite=core' to expose only canonical tools and conserve token budget.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Why use mcp.waqf.dev instead of individual MCP servers?
faq.a1: A single configuration eliminates managing 10+ server endpoints, prevents tool name collisions, caches authentic texts at the edge, and provides canonical tools that save context window tokens.
faq.a2: Yes, this gateway is 100% open-source and endowed as a digital waqf for public benefit.
faq.a3: We do not store private API keys or personal prompts. Anonymized operational telemetry (country, tool called, response latency) is recorded strictly for health and capacity monitoring.
